title: A picklist with no values given
transcript:
Consultant: You mentioned the sales stages are a mess.
Client: They are. Every rep uses a different set, because it is a free text box.
Consultant: So you want a fixed list.
Client: We need the stage on the opportunity to be a proper picklist so
everyone uses the same words.
Consultant: Which stages do you want?
Client: That is the argument we are having internally. Sales wants seven,
the VP wants four. I cannot give you the list today.
Consultant: Fine, we will note the field and come back to the values.

expected.note: The field is genuinely requested; the values are explicitly not decided.

notes: Correct behaviour is to extract the field with low confidence and flag it, not to invent a plausible set of stage values.
